transferable_rules: Separate trainable parameter-family local updates from aggregation eligibility, synchronization assignment and copy identity. Exclusion from aggregation is not freezing; equal assigned values do not imply one parameter entity between synchronizations.

Keep learned parameters, computed statistics and optimizer state distinct. Qualify sharing/retention by stage and preserve independently supported testing exceptions. Unknown running/counter/reset/communication semantics remain unknown.
